excerpt: Top Reasons LMIA-Based Work Permit Applications Get Refused by IRCC Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. A Labour Market Impact Assessment (LMIA) is a key requirement for many Canadian employers seeking to hire foreign workers. Once an LMIA is approved, the foreign national can apply for a work permit. While LMIA approval is a positive step, it does not guarantee that Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) will issue a work permit. In fact, many LMIA-based work permit applications are refused due to avoidable errors, missing information, or concerns
